role: CI guard (make science-register; ci.yml and gates.yml) that Tools/science_register/register.json classifies every score-adjusting heuristic, stays in sync with ScoringVersion.current, contains no retracted claims, and keeps its entry count at or above a ratcheted floor.
toplevel: cd to repo root; exit 2 if any of the three inputs is missing. Python: parse register (exit 2 on any exception); VALID = keys of _status_meanings (exit 2 if empty). Per entry: duplicate id, status not in VALID, empty affects/evidence/allowed_language, and any `tests` path that does not exist are problems. Reads `static let current = "..."` from ScoringVersion.swift (exit 2 if absent) and flags register.scoring_version mismatch (both v3.1.oct2026 at 8d32097). If _retracted_claims.claims non-empty: substring-scans each entry's evidence/affects/allowed_language/notes (str or list) and every .swift/.md file under Emuqu/Sources and docs/ for each claim. Discovery: regex `func <name>(Adjustment|Penalty|Bonus|Modifier|Damper|Fraction)` across Emuqu/Sources/Analysis/**/*.swift except paths containing CauseDetection/ (names ending Descriptions/Message dropped); unclaimed (not in any entry's `symbols` nor in _waived_symbols keys not starting '_') and stale (claimed/waived but not discovered) names are problems. Budget = int(file) with no error handling (a non-integer raises ValueError -> traceback, exit 1 not 2). Prints problems to stderr, a tally line, exits 1 on any problem; exits 1 if count < floor; prints 'raise floor' advisory (still passes) if count > floor; else 'clean'. Discovery only sees the listed name suffixes; a heuristic named otherwise is invisible (the header says so).
